senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צָפָה)to look up to, respect, regard, v. סָפַן.
to provide, store away, reserve, guard; to hide.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 2:1">Prov. II, 1</cite>) <he>אתם צוֹפְנִים … ואני צוֹפֵן וכ׳</he> you treasure up learning and good deeds with me in this world, and I treasure up for you good reward in the hereafter (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 31:20">Ps. XXXI, 20</cite>); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:14">Cant. R. to VII, 14</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00676"><he>צָפוּן</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="R00679"><he>צְפוּנָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>צְפוּנִים</he>, <he>צְפוּנִין</he>; <he>צְפוּנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 2:1">Midr. Prov. to ch. II</cite> <he>אם זכיתם להַצְפִּין תורתי … מטוב הצ׳ וכ׳</he> if you do well, guarding my Law (making provision for the study of the Law), I will satisfy you out of the good which is reserved for the hereafter (ref. to Ps. l. c.).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:11">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <he>צפנה וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 1:11">Lev. I, 11</cite>) <he>כנגד מעשיהם … שהם צ׳ לפניו</he> this is typical of the deeds of Abraham …, which are stored up before him (the Lord, for the benefit of their descendants); v. <cite ref="R00679"><he>צְפוּנָה</he></cite>. Midr. Prov. l. c. (ref. to <he>יצפן</he>, ib. II, 7) <he>משעה שאדם … צ׳ לו</he> while man is formed in his mother’s womb, (the reward for) the Law which he will study is reserved for him.

<cite ref="Sukkah 52a:9">Succ. 52ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>הצפוני</he>, <cite ref="Joel 2:20">Joel II, 20</cite>) <he>זה יצר הרע שצ׳ ועומד בלבו וכ׳</he> that means the evil inclination that constantly lies in waiting in the heart of man.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:4">Gen. R. s. 90</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:2">Yalk. ib. 148</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00511"><he>יָפַע</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be reserved, kept. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Yithro 8 ונ׳ לשלש וכ׳ and he (Moses) was reserved for three months (for the giving of the Law in the third month, Ex. XIX, 1); Yalk. Ex. 271; ib. ונצפון (corr. acc.).
to guard, provide; to remove, hide. Midr. Prov. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <he>צפנה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:3">Deut. II, 3</cite>) <he>הַצְפִּינוּ עצמיכם ממנו</he> hide yourselves from him; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:8">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>יַצְפִּין</he> let him turn towards the north (in prayer).

senses.gloss: (denom. of צָפוֹן I) to brighten, cleanse with soap, v. צָפוֹן I. I.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b:14">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>הַצְפִּינֵנוּ היכן</he> … <he>צפון</he> ‘unhide’ unto us where R. … is hidden; [Rashi refers to <cite ref="R00672"><he>צָפָה</he></cite>, with emphatic <cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite>].
